tasks.label: 1. Preview the site
tasks.detail: Opens the curriculum in your browser so you can look at it. Leave it running.

tasks.label: 2. Publish from the Word document
tasks.detail: Rebuilds the whole website from the Word document and puts it live. Same as the Publish button.

tasks.label: 3. Check the Word document without publishing
tasks.detail: Does everything except put it live. Use it to see what would change, or to find mistakes.

tasks.label: 4. Check the converter still matches the site
tasks.detail: For maintainers: proves converting the Word document gives back the site as it stands.
